threat_event: A title disbursement is diverted by a spoofed payoff letter or changed seller proceeds instructions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payoff letters and proceeds instructions still arrive by email from lenders and sellers; callback depends on staff following the procedure
affected_asset_or_process: Title escrow trust accounts; SYS-M2; SYS-G5
existing_controls: Callback to verified numbers; dual approval; hardware-key release; positive pay
treatment_plan: Payoff verification through lender portals; quarterly callback compliance audit (30 files)

threat_event: A Home Loans funding wire to an outside settlement agent is diverted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Outside settlement agent wire instructions are accepted from email with callback, but no closing protection letter check
treatment_plan: Approved settlement agent list with verified accounts

threat_event: Title closes a sale for an impostor seller of vacant property
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote sellers of vacant land and non-owner-occupied homes; identity checks by notary only
existing_controls: Identity verification service for buyers and sellers in SYS-B2
treatment_plan: Enhanced seller verification for vacant property and remote sellers

threat_event: AVM estimates used in credit decisions are unreliable or discriminatory without the required quality control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AVM quality control policy adopted 2025; no random sample testing; no nondiscrimination review
regulatory_driver: Reg Z 12 CFR 1026.42(i)(3); Fair Housing Act 42 U.S.C. 3605
existing_controls: AVM vendor validation summary; appraisal for loans outside AVM eligibility
treatment_plan: Quarterly random sample testing against appraisals; nondiscrimination review by neighborhood demographics; conflict of interest review (P10)

threat_event: The pre-qualification model produces disparities or unexplained outcomes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model not tested for disparities since 2024; reasons for lower pre-qualified amounts not shown to consumers
regulatory_driver: ECOA Reg B 12 CFR 1002.9; Fair Housing Act 42 U.S.C. 3605
existing_controls: Loan officer review before any application decision
treatment_plan: Disparity testing; reason statements; counsel review of when a pre-qualification request is an application (P10)

threat_event: A breach at the loan origination vendor or borrower portal exposes about 1.3 million consumers
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 reviewed; MFA for borrowers optional
treatment_plan: Require borrower MFA; purge withdrawn applications past retention

threat_event: Payee or bank changes in SYS-M2 go undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-M2 audit logs not in the SIEM
treatment_plan: Collect SYS-M2 logs; alert on payee changes after the settlement statement is final

threat_event: The title production vendor cannot restore service within the BIA RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor contract RTO 12 hours against BIA 8 hours
existing_controls: Manual commitment process for urgent files
treatment_plan: Contract amendment at renewal; vendor DR test witnessed by Title

threat_event: An FTC notification is missed because affected consumers cannot be counted per institution
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mailbox and file reviews do not tag consumers by financial institution
treatment_plan: Per-institution counting procedure and data map

threat_event: Ransomware at title offices halts closings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Closing room devices and local scanners
treatment_plan: Closing room device hardening; offline closing kit

threat_event: A cybersecurity event notice to a state insurance regulator is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: States that enacted a version of NAIC Model #668 are not listed in the matrix
treatment_plan: List adopting states with deadlines and contacts in the matrix

threat_event: Leads from the brokerage and Homebuilding are used by Home Loans without consent records or the affiliated business disclosure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Point-to-point lead APIs with no consent fields
existing_controls: Disclosure given at referral by agents and sales consultants
treatment_plan: Consent and disclosure fields required before a lead is accepted

threat_event: The senior officers of Home Loans and Title cannot evidence oversight of the Qualified Individual and the parent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Intercompany services agreement without security terms
existing_controls: Annual written report to both boards (2026-09-17)
treatment_plan: Amend agreement; quarterly oversight meeting with minutes

threat_event: Scanned closing files from 2006 to 2015 on a file server are exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: File server retained past need; broad read access for Title staff
treatment_plan: Purge files past retention; move needed files to SYS-M2 archive

threat_event: Title production vendor support staff misuse remote access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor remote tool outside group PAM
treatment_plan: Vendor access only through group PAM with approval and recording

threat_event: The identity verification service wrongly rejects some consumers more than others (AI-006)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No error rate data by age or skin tone from the vendor
existing_controls: Manual Title review path for every failed check
treatment_plan: Obtain vendor demographic error rates; track manual review outcomes

threat_event: The FinCEN residential real estate rule is restored and Title has no reporting procedure
treatment_plan: Ready procedure and SYS-M2 data fields

threat_event: Home Loans fails to file a required suspicious activity report for fraud involving a loan
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Fraud cases handled by Title and the SOC are not routed to the Home Loans BSA officer
treatment_plan: Route every loan-related fraud case to the BSA officer within 1 business day
